text:
Priya (CS): Quick heads-upNovaTech renewal in 7 days. They want to shorten from 12mo -> 9mo, add +15 seats, and request split invoicing across EU (Entity A) and US (Entity B). Asking if onboarding credit can be applied pro rata to the new term. Any immediate blockers?
Sam (Sales): Price question first: do we hold unit price for 9mo or bump for shorter term? Customer wants parity.
Priya (CS): They insisted on same unit price in the call. Procurement requires two invoices for chargeback reasons. Could slow PO turnaround.
Tom (Legal): Separate invoices are contract-acceptable, but I need full legal entity names, tax IDs, and the exact PO text. I'll prepare a short amendment covering term change, seat delta, and credit allocation.
Maria (Billing): Invoice-split is feasible. Need vendor codes + billing contacts for both entities. EU invoice will need VAT treatment; confirm if customer is VAT-registered.
Priya (CS): Customer prefers credit applied pro rata by invoice amount. They also want onboarding credit to be usable against first invoice only if possible.
Maria (Billing): Our system applies credits at billing account level. We can split a one-time credit across invoices pro rata if legal/finance approves.
Alex (PM): On enablement front, customer requests a 30-day kickstart and a go-live checklist with success criteria. We can do 2 onboarding workshops and a recorded walkthrough.
Sam (Sales): I'll hold the unit price flat and flag any internal approvals if discount is needed.
Tom (Legal): Draft clause I'll include: "Onboarding credit to be allocated pro rata across invoices for the 9-month term unless otherwise agreed in writing." Will route via DocuSign.
BillingBot: Invoice preview generated:
```
INVOICE PREVIEW
NovaTech EU (Entity A) - 9,600 EUR - 10 seats (9mo prorated)
NovaTech US (Entity B) - $8,400 USD - 5 seats (9mo prorated)
Onboarding credit: 2,000 (split pro rata)
```
Priya (CS): Important timing note: Billing needs PO numbers by EOD Thursday to hit next billing run. Procurement said their finance team may need extra days for cross-entity approvals.
Maria (Billing): Confirmed. If we don't get PO/vendor codes by EOD Thu, invoices will be issued next cycle and payment timing shifts.
Tom (Legal): I'll drop the amendment in DocuSign this afternoon. Please confirm the billing names and PO text before I send.
Sam (Sales): I'll ask NovaTech for vendor codes, tax IDs, and both PO numbers now.
Priya (CS): I'll send the consolidated onboarding checklist to NovaTech and ask for preferred dates for sessions. Alex - can you tentatively hold 2x 90-min slots in week 1 post-sign?
Alex (PM): Holding tentative slots. Will prep a short go-live checklist and acceptance criteria doc.
Priya (CS): Next steps summary:
- Sam: collect vendor codes, PO numbers, tax IDs (owner)
- Tom: finalize amendment + DocuSign (legal)
- Maria: prepare split-invoice templates + pre-author preview (billing)
- Alex: prep enablement checklist and tentative session times (PM)
I'll update renewal tracker and ping if any delays. Thanks team :rocket:
